transcript.answer: Cloud Run in `europe-north1` was never built, and its reason for existing went away. Issue #27 chose that region so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model, which was meant to satisfy OLT's NIS-2 condition. The condition was that re:cinq must be able to document and prove that data doesn't leave the controlled hosting environment. Later measurements (2026-10-16 and 2026-10-19) showed `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 models, which retire on 2026-10-20. After that date no Gemini model on Vertex runs in `europe-north1`. The current models (3.x and 4) are EU-resident only through the `eu` multi-region. So Otto instead deploys to the shared GKE cluster (`n8n-cluster`) in `europe-west1`, with the model on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. ADR-003 (PR #416) records this. #27 is closed as superseded, and the Cloud Run requirements in the deployment spec are marked superseded. The planned ADR-001 was never written, because ADR-001 is now the TMS authentication decision. I did not find a separate explanation of why the team picked GKE over Cloud Run beyond the shared cluster already existing.

judgements.reason: The answer states that europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retired on 2026-10-20, and that newer models are available only on the eu multi-region, so Otto runs on GKE n8n-cluster in europe-west1; this matches the gold answer.
